title: the build and test cycle is too slow and the target directory grows without bound: measure where the time actually goes in the local loop and in CI, then fix what the measurement names

waves.summary: Measure where the cycle's time actually goes — locally on Windows and in CI — and write the numbers into the tree, so every later change is decided by a datum instead of a plausible story.
Stop CI from compiling the whole workspace three times per operating system, and make its incremental policy explicit instead of inherited.
Bound the incremental cache by a policy declared in the repository, so 52 GB cannot accumulate again while everyone waits for someone to remember a command.
